messages.subject: why my app using shinyapps.io, it turns gray out in the browser later of few minutes?
parts:
Hi,
i'm learning shiny and i'm building a app in `shiny` using the library `shinyapps` for deploy app in shinyapps.io,
with the next code:

      library(shinyapps)
    deployApp(appDir=getwd(),appName="myApp")

it works correctly but later few minutes the app turns gray in the browser, as inactive

please, 
how can i solve this problem?
